title: Homestyle Dal Tadka (Ghee Jeera)
instructions: Pressure cook washed toor and moong dal with turmeric and salt for 3 whistles.
Whisk cooked dal until creamy.
Heat ghee, crackle cumin seeds, fry golden garlic slices, dry chillies, and hing.
Pour hot tadka over the dal, cover immediately for 2 minutes to trap smoke.
Garnish with coriander and serve with steamed rice.

title: Restaurant Style Dal Makhani
instructions: Pressure cook soaked black urad and rajma for 5 whistles until soft.
Mash lightly with a ladle to release natural creaminess.
In a handi, cook ginger garlic paste and tomato puree in butter until oil separates.
Add dal with broth; simmer on low flame for 25 minutes stirring often.
Finish with cream, white butter, and crushed roasted kasuri methi.

title: Panchmel Dal (Rajasthani 5-Dal)

ingredients.name: Mix of Toor, Moong, Chana, Urad & Masoor Dal

instructions: Boil the 5 mixed lentils with turmeric and salt for 4 whistles.
Temper whole spices, tomatoes, and dry masala powders in hot ghee.
Combine lentils with spiced gravy, simmer 10 minutes, and serve with baati or rotis.

title: Chana Dal Lauki (Bottle Gourd)
instructions: Pressure cook chana dal and lauki cubes together with turmeric for 3 whistles.
Prepare a ginger, tomato, and cumin seed tadka in ghee.
Pour tadka into the dal and simmer for 5 minutes. Nutritious, cooling homestyle meal.

title: Dal Palak (Spinach Lentils)
instructions: Cook toor dal with chopped spinach and salt for 3 whistles.
Temper lots of garlic, cumin, and chillies in ghee.
Fold into the spinach dal and finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

title: Maa Chole ki Dal (Punjabi Langar Dal)
instructions: Boil split urad and chana dal for 4 whistles until thick and porridge-like.
Sauté onions, ginger, and tomatoes in ghee until glossy.
Mix into the lentils and simmer on low for 15 minutes. Pure langar taste.

title: Moong Dal Khichdi (Desi Ghee)
instructions: Roast cumin and peppercorns in ghee with hing and ginger.
Add rice, moong dal, 4 cups water, and salt.
Pressure cook for 3 whistles until soft and melting. Top with extra ghee.

title: Gujarati Khatti Meethi Dal
instructions: Boil toor dal with peanuts for 3 whistles; blend smooth.
Simmer with tamarind, jaggery, ginger, and spices for 10 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds, cloves, cinnamon, and curry leaves in ghee and pour over.

title: Udupi Sambar
instructions: Boil toor dal and drumstick veggies separately.
Simmer veggies in tamarind water with sambar powder.
Stir in mashed dal, temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil.

title: Tomato Pepper Rasam
instructions: Boil crushed tomatoes with tamarind, turmeric, and water for 6 mins.
Add freshly ground black pepper, cumin, and garlic.
Temper mustard, hing, and curry leaves in hot ghee, pour over and turn off flame immediately.

title: Dal Banjari (Smoked Chana Dal)
instructions: Boil chana dal and urad dal with cloves and cinnamon for 4 whistles.
Temper plenty of garlic slices and dry red chillies in smoking hot ghee.
Infuse with charcoal smoke (dhungar) for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Masoor Dal Tadka (Red Lentils)

ingredients.name: Whole Brown Masoor / Red Split Masoor

instructions: Cook red masoor dal for just 2 whistles (cooks ultra fast).
Temper with onions, tomatoes, green chillies, and curry leaves in desi ghee.

title: Dhaba Style Paneer Bhurji
instructions: Heat ghee in kadhai; sauté cumin and finely chopped onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic and green chillies, cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, pav bhaji masala, and salt. Cook until oil separates.
Fold in crumbled paneer and roasted kasuri methi. Cook 2 mins and serve hot.

title: Paneer Butter Masala (Makhani)
instructions: Blend soaked cashews with tomatoes into velvety smooth paste.
Cook puree in butter with ginger garlic paste and Kashmiri chilli until deep orange.
Add splash of water, paneer cubes, and simmer 6 minutes.
Stir in fresh cream, honey/sugar pinch, and crushed kasuri methi.

title: Kadai Paneer (Capsicum & Onion)

ingredients.name: Roasted Kadai Masala (Coriander, Cumin, Red Chilli)

instructions: Dry roast and coarsely grind whole coriander seeds and dry red chillies.
Sauté capsicum and onion petals on high flame until smoky.
Cook tomato masala, add kadai spice, toss in paneer and crunchy veggies.
Cook 4 mins on medium heat and serve with garlic naan.

title: Shahi Paneer (White Mughlai Gravy)
instructions: Cook cardamom and whole spices in ghee, add boiled white onion cashew paste.
Whisk in yogurt smoothly on low flame so it does not curdle.
Gently add paneer cubes, saffron milk or kewra drops, and white pepper.
Simmer 5 minutes for a royal velvety white curry.

title: Silky Dhaba Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch palak in boiling water 2 mins and shock in cold water for bright green hue.
Puree with green chillies. Sauté crushed garlic and onions in ghee.
Add puree, simmer 5 minutes, fold in paneer cubes and fresh cream.

title: Dhaba Aloo Gobi Adraki
instructions: Sear potatoes and gobi in smoking mustard oil with cumin and ginger juliennes.
Add turmeric, red chilli, and salt; cover and steam 10 minutes without water.
Uncover, toss with amchur powder and fresh coriander until crisp.

title: Bhindi Masala Do Pyaza
instructions: Wipe bhindi completely dry before chopping to avoid sliminess.
Pan-fry bhindi in oil until 80% tender and remove.
Sauté onions, add dry spices, return bhindi and toss on high flame for 4 minutes.

title: Baingan Bharta (Smoky Roasted)
instructions: Slit eggplant, insert garlic cloves, and roast directly on open stove flame until charred.
Peel skin and mash smoky pulp.
Sauté onions, tomatoes, and green chillies in mustard oil; fold in mashed baingan and cook 8 minutes.

title: Kashmiri Dum Aloo
instructions: Boil baby potatoes for 1 whistle, prick with fork, and deep fry until golden crust forms.
Whisk curd with saunf, sonth, and Kashmiri chilli powder.
Pour into hot mustard oil, cook until oil separates, add fried potatoes and dum-cook 10 mins.

title: Malai Kofta (Melt in Mouth)
instructions: Shape paneer-potato mixture with raisins inside into round balls and deep fry until golden.
Cook smooth cashew-tomato gravy with butter and aromatic spices.
Place fried koftas on a serving dish and pour simmering hot gravy over just before serving.

title: Methi Matar Malai
instructions: Sauté chopped methi leaves with a pinch of salt to remove bitterness.
Cook cashew paste in ghee with cardamom; add boiled green peas.
Stir in sautéed methi and fold in rich fresh malai/cream. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Amritsari Pindi Chana
instructions: Boil soaked chickpeas with a black tea bag and salt for 5 whistles until soft.
Toss with dry spices: anardana, chole masala, amchur.
Pour sizzling ghee tadka with ginger juliennes directly over the chickpeas; simmer 8 mins.

title: Punjabi Tariwala Rajma
instructions: Pressure cook soaked rajma with salt for 5 whistles until tender.
Cook onion-tomato masala in ghee until glossy and oil releases.
Combine with boiled rajma, mash a few beans to thicken gravy, and simmer on low 15 mins. Pair with rice!

title: High-Protein Soya Chunk Curry
instructions: Boil soya chunks 5 mins, squeeze out excess water, and marinate in curd and chilli powder.
Lightly sear marinated chunks in pan 3 mins.
Cook spicy onion-tomato gravy, add soya chunks and 1 cup water, simmer 10 minutes.

title: Soya Chaap Masala Gravy
instructions: Cut soya chaap, fry in hot oil until layers puff up crisp.
Simmer in rich dhaba spiced tomato gravy with cream and kasuri methi.
Meat-like texture packed with 36g plant protein.

title: Rajasthani Gatte ki Sabzi
instructions: Knead besan dough with ajwain and ghee; roll into logs and boil in water 10 mins.
Slice cooked logs into gattas.
Cook whisked yogurt with turmeric and coriander in ghee; add gatta pieces and simmer.

title: Mushroom Matar Masala
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms on high heat until golden and water evaporates.
Add green peas and spiced onion-tomato masala with half cup warm water.
Simmer 6 minutes until gravy thickens; garnish with coriander.

title: Sarson ka Saag (Makki Roti Partner)
instructions: Pressure cook cleaned greens with ginger, garlic, and chillies for 4 whistles.
Mash greens with a wooden masher while whisking in makki ka atta.
Slow cook 20 mins; finish with a sizzling garlic-ghee tadka and top with fresh white butter.

title: Jeera Aloo (Cumin Potatoes)
instructions: Crackle generous cumin seeds and slit chillies in hot ghee.
Add boiled potato cubes, turmeric, red chilli, and amchur powder.
Toss on medium-high flame for 5 minutes until crispy edges form.

title: Kurkuri Crispy Bhindi Fry
instructions: Toss thin bhindi strips in besan, rice flour, chilli powder, and chaat masala.
Shallow fry in hot oil on medium flame until golden and shatteringly crisp.
Serve immediately as a crunchy side with dal chawal.

title: Lauki Kofta Curry
instructions: Mix squeezed lauki with besan and spices; fry small round koftas until golden.
Simmer in light spiced onion-tomato gravy for 8 minutes.
Add fried koftas right before serving so they stay soft and tender.

title: Paneer Lababdar
instructions: Simmer rich tomato gravy with butter and aromatic whole spices.
Fold in grated paneer directly into the gravy for thick luxurious texture.
Add paneer cubes and fresh cream; simmer 4 minutes.

title: Stuffed Bharwa Shimla Mirch
instructions: Stuff hollowed capsicums with seasoned potato-paneer filling.
Pan fry in mustard oil on low flame, rotating sides until charred and tender (15 mins).

title: Mix Veg Kolhapuri (Spicy)
instructions: Roast dry coconut, sesame, and whole spices into fiery Kolhapuri masala paste.
Sauté mixed vegetables in the spicy paste with 1 cup water until cooked tender.

title: Tindora / Kundru Masala Fry
instructions: Sauté sliced tindora in hot mustard oil with mustard seeds.
Cover and cook 10 minutes on low; add dry spices and fry crisp.

title: Aloo Matar (Homestyle Gravy)
instructions: Pressure cook potatoes, peas, and onion-tomato gravy with 1 cup water for 2 whistles.
Mash a few potato pieces to thicken the comforting gravy. Finish with coriander.

title: Paneer Tikka Masala (Smoky Tawa)

ingredients.name: Spicy Tomato Gravy with Kasuri Methi

instructions: Pan-sear marinated paneer tikka with capsicum on high flame until charred.
Simmer in buttery tomato-cream sauce for 5 minutes.

title: Chana Masala (Dhaba Gravy)
instructions: Boil chickpeas 4 whistles until soft. Cook rich onion-tomato masala in ghee.
Add chana with half cup water and simmer on low flame for 12 minutes.

title: Aloo Methi (Dry Winter Sabzi)
instructions: Sauté garlic slices and green chillies in hot mustard oil.
Add potatoes and fresh methi leaves; cook uncovered on medium flame until methi softens and potatoes turn crisp.

title: Dum Aloo Banarasi
instructions: Scoop out baby potatoes, stuff with crumbled spiced paneer and nuts, and deep fry.
Simmer in golden tomato-cashew-poppy seed gravy for 10 minutes on low dum.

title: Crispy Paneer-Stuffed Moong Dal Chilla
instructions: Spread moong dal batter into a thin circular crepe on a hot tawa.
Drizzle ghee, flip once, and fill with grated paneer and herbs.
Fold and serve with green chutney.

title: Mumbai Chowpatty Pav Bhaji
instructions: Boil veggies 3 whistles; vigorously mash on tawa with butter, onions, tomatoes, and masala.
Simmer 8 minutes with extra butter and serve with toasted pav.

title: Indori Poha (Jeeravan Masala)

ingredients.name: Mustard Seeds, Green Chillies, Curry Leaves

instructions: Rinse poha and drain thoroughly. Temper mustard, chillies, peanuts in oil.
Toss in poha with turmeric, salt, and sugar pinch.
Garnish with crunchy sev, fresh pomegranate seeds, and spicy Jeeravan powder.

title: South Indian Masala Dosa
instructions: Spread batter paper-thin on cast iron tawa; drizzle ghee until crisp and golden.
Place spiced potato filling in the center, roll into a cylinder.
Serve with coconut chutney and hot sambar.

title: Steamed Soft Idli with Sambar
instructions: Pour batter into oiled idli plates and steam for 10 minutes until fluffy and cloud-soft.
Serve dipped in piping hot vegetable sambar.

title: Crispy Medu Vada
instructions: Whisk thick urad dal batter with peppercorns and curry leaves until aerated.
Shape doughnut rings with wet hands and deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Classic Punjabi Aloo Paratha
instructions: Roll dough, stuff generously with spiced potato mixture, and seal carefully.
Roll out flat and roast on hot tawa with generous ghee until blistered and golden.
Serve with cold curd and homemade mango pickle.

title: Paneer Onion Paratha
instructions: Stuff rolled wheat dough with spiced grated paneer and onions.
Roast on tawa until crisp on both sides. High protein fuel for your morning.

title: Methi Thepla (Travel Friendly)
instructions: Knead dough using curd, methi, sesame seeds, and spices.
Roll thin and roast lightly on tawa with oil. Stays soft for days!

title: Gujarati Nylon Khaman Dhokla

ingredients.name: Mustard, Green Chillies & Sugar Water Tadka

instructions: Whisk besan with lemon juice, turmeric, and water; add Eno right before steaming.
Steam 12 mins in cooker without whistle. Pour sweet and tangy mustard tadka water.

title: Sabudana Khichdi (Vrat Special)
instructions: Soak sabudana until pearls separate easily without stickiness.
Sauté cumin, chillies, and boiled potatoes in ghee; fold in sabudana and crushed peanuts.
Cook covered on low 4 mins until pearls turn translucent.

title: Delhi Samosa Chaat

ingredients.name: Sweet Imli Chutney & Spicy Mint Chutney

instructions: Crush hot samosas in a shallow bowl; top with warm spiced chickpea curry.
Drizzle sweet tamarind chutney, spicy green chutney, and creamy dahi.
Top with crunchy nylon sev and fresh coriander.

title: Mumbai Vada Pav (Dry Garlic Chutney)
instructions: Dip spiced potato balls in seasoned gram flour batter and deep fry.
Slit pav, spread green chutney and fiery red dry garlic coconut chutney.
Insert hot vada, press down and serve with fried salted chillies.

title: Hyderabadi Veg Dum Biryani
instructions: Layer spiced marinated vegetables in handi, top with parboiled aromatic basmati rice.
Sprinkle birista, mint, saffron milk, and generous desi ghee.
Seal handi lid with dough and cook on low dum flame for 20 minutes.

title: Restaurant Jeera Rice
instructions: Crackle cumin seeds and bay leaf in hot ghee until deeply fragrant.
Add washed basmati rice, sauté 1 minute, add 2 cups water and salt.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles; fluff gently with a fork.

title: South Indian Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)

ingredients.name: Mustard, Urad Dal, Curry Leaves, Ginger

instructions: Mash warm soft rice; mix with fresh curd and a splash of milk so it stays sweet.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, ginger, and curry leaves; pour over.
Top with fresh crunchy pomegranate seeds.

title: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
instructions: Heat oil, fry crunchy peanuts, chana dal, mustard, chillies, and turmeric.
Turn off heat, stir in fresh lemon juice.
Gently toss with cold cooked rice until evenly yellow and aromatic.

title: Mumbai Tawa Pulao
instructions: On a wide tawa, melt butter and cook crunchy vegetables with pav bhaji masala.
Toss cooked basmati rice vigorously with the spicy buttery bhaji mix for 3 minutes.

title: Kashmiri Sweet & Nutty Pulao
instructions: Cook basmati rice with whole spices and saffron.
Gently mix in roasted dry fruits, sliced fresh fruits, and ghee.

title: Karnataka Bisi Bele Bath
instructions: Pressure cook rice, lentils, and mixed vegetables together for 3 whistles.
Simmer with tamarind water and freshly roasted spicy-cinnamon masala powder.
Temper crunchy cashews and curry leaves in hot ghee and pour over.

title: Matar Pulao (Green Peas Rice)
instructions: Sauté cumin, cloves, cardamom, and green peas in ghee.
Add basmati rice, 2 cups water, and cook for 2 whistles. Aromatic and tender.

title: Pudina Mint Rice
instructions: Sauté mint paste in ghee until fragrant; mix with basmati rice and 2 cups water for 2 whistles.

title: Tomato Bath / Tomato Rice
instructions: Cook spiced tomato gravy with whole spices in pressure cooker.
Add rice, pressure cook 2 whistles. Tangy and spicy south Indian favorite.

title: Old Delhi Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tandoori spices; pan-sear until charred.
Simmer smooth tomato-cashew gravy with butter and mild spices.
Add chicken pieces, simmer 8 minutes, finish with cream, butter, and kasuri methi.

title: Dhaba Style Chicken Curry (Tariwala)
instructions: Heat mustard oil to smoking point; sear chicken pieces until lightly browned.
Sauté sliced onions, ginger-garlic, and whole spices until dark brown (bhunao).
Add chicken, 1.5 cups water, and pressure cook for 3 whistles. Thin spicy gravy for rice!

title: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani

ingredients.name: Marinated Chicken (Yogurt, Fried Onion, Biryani Masala)
Long Grain Aged Basmati Rice (70% Cooked)

instructions: Marinate chicken overnight in spiced yogurt, ginger garlic, and mint.
Place chicken at the bottom of a heavy pot; layer fragrant parboiled basmati rice over.
Drizzle saffron milk, rose water, and ghee; seal with dough and dum-cook 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala (Smoky Gravy)
instructions: Sear chicken tikka in a smoking hot pan.
Cook spicy, tangy onion-tomato gravy with capsicum petals.
Toss chicken into gravy, simmer 5 minutes, finish with cream and coriander.

title: Kadai Chicken (Peshawari Style)
instructions: Dry roast coriander seeds and dry red chillies; crush coarsely.
Stir-fry chicken, capsicum, and onions in high heat with the spicy kadai masala.

title: Chicken Chettinad (Fiery Black Pepper)

ingredients.name: Roasted Chettinad Masala (Fennel, Pepper, Poppy Seeds)

instructions: Grind roasted spices with fresh coconut into thick Chettinad paste.
Sauté shallots and curry leaves in coconut oil, add chicken and masala paste.
Pressure cook 2 whistles until intensely aromatic and peppery.

title: Chicken Korma (Shahi Mughlai)
instructions: Cook whole aromatic spices in ghee, add chicken and sear lightly.
Stir in whisked yogurt and fried onion almond paste; cook on low dum until oil floats.

title: Tandoori Chicken (Air Fryer / Oven)

ingredients.name: Kashmiri Red Chilli, Ginger Garlic & Mustard Oil

instructions: Make deep cuts in chicken; marinate with lemon juice, salt, and ginger-garlic (first marinade).
Apply thick hung curd, mustard oil, and tandoori spices (second marinade).
Air-fry at 200°C for 18-20 minutes or pan-sear until charred and juicy.

title: Chicken Keema Matar
instructions: Sauté ginger garlic and onions in ghee until brown.
Add chicken keema, break lumps with a spatula, and cook on high heat 5 minutes.
Add green peas, tomatoes, garam masala, cover and simmer 10 mins. Serve with pav!

title: Chicken Saagwala (Palak Chicken)
instructions: Sear chicken pieces with onions and garlic in ghee.
Add blanched spinach puree and spices; pressure cook for 2 whistles.

title: Chicken 65 (Crispy South Indian)
instructions: Marinate chicken in spiced curd, egg white, rice flour, and red chilli.
Deep fry until golden crisp. Toss with tempered curry leaves and garlic.

title: Indo-Chinese Chilli Chicken
instructions: Sauté heaps of garlic, chillies, capsicum, and onions in a flaming hot wok.
Add dark soy, green chilli sauce, and cornstarch slurry.
Toss crispy chicken pieces until coated in glossy sauce.

title: Methi Chicken (Fenugreek Chicken)
instructions: Sauté methi leaves lightly to reduce bitterness.
Cook chicken with onion-tomato-curd masala; fold in methi leaves and simmer 10 mins.

title: Malvani Chicken Sukka (Dry Coconut)
instructions: Pressure cook chicken with turmeric and salt 2 whistles.
Roast coconut paste with Malvani spices until dark and fragrant.
Toss cooked chicken into coconut masala until completely coated and dry.

title: Chicken Shawarma Protein Bowl
instructions: Marinate chicken breast in cumin, coriander, paprika, and garlic; grill 6 mins each side.
Slice grilled chicken over fresh crisp salad with garlic curd dressing.

title: Kolhapuri Chicken (Fiery Red Curry)
instructions: Sear chicken in smoking oil, add roasted dark coconut masala and Kolhapuri spices.
Pressure cook 3 whistles. Extremely spicy and rich rassa.

title: Chicken Do Pyaza
instructions: Cook chicken with chopped onions until tender.
Add crispy onion petals in the last 4 minutes of cooking for signature two-onion texture.

title: Chicken Rezala (Bengali White Curry)
instructions: Slow simmer chicken in cashew-poppy seed curd gravy with dry red chillies and kewra water.

title: Chicken Sukka (Mangalore Kori Sukka)
instructions: Cook chicken in spiced tamarind broth.
Toss with freshly roasted coarse coconut mixture until dry. Pairs amazingly with neer dosa.

title: Chicken Malai Tikka (Melt in Mouth)
instructions: Marinate chicken in cream, hung curd, ginger garlic, cheese, and cardamom.
Pan grill or air-fry on high heat until charred spots appear and meat stays juicy.

title: Pepper Chicken Fry (Andhra Style)
instructions: Pan-roast chicken in coconut oil with heaps of curry leaves, garlic, and fresh crushed black pepper until dry.

title: Hariyali Chicken Tikka (Green Herbs)
instructions: Marinate in cilantro-mint-green chilli paste with hung curd.
Grill on skewers 12 minutes. Lean, vibrant, and packed with clean protein.

title: Chicken Lababdar
instructions: Simmer spiced chicken in luscious tomato cashew gravy with grated paneer for extra body.

title: Chicken Kali Mirch (Black Pepper Cream)
instructions: Simmer chicken in white cashew-curd gravy studded with coarsely cracked black peppercorns.

title: Honey Chilli Chicken
instructions: Toss crispy fried chicken strips in honey, red chilli paste, garlic, and vinegar.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and spring onion greens.

title: Kashmiri Mutton Rogan Josh
instructions: Brown mutton in smoking mustard oil with whole cloves and cardamom.
Add whisked curd and Kashmiri chilli paste, stirring vigorously on low heat.
Add fennel and dry ginger powder with water; pressure cook 5 whistles until meat falls off bone.

title: Champaran Handi Mutton (Ahuna Meat)
instructions: Mix raw mutton with sliced onions, whole garlic heads, raw mustard oil, and crushed whole spices.
Seal in clay handi or heavy pressure cooker; cook on low heat for 4 whistles without stirring.
Garlic heads soften into sweet buttery spread; meat becomes fork-tender.

title: Rajasthani Laal Maas
instructions: Brown mutton in generous desi ghee with lots of garlic.
Add Mathania chilli paste and beaten curd; pressure cook for 5 whistles.
Infuse with a hot piece of burning charcoal drizzled with ghee (Dhungar) for signature smokiness.

title: Hyderabadi Mutton Dum Biryani
instructions: Tenderize mutton with raw papaya paste and aromatic spices for 4 hours.
Layer with 70% boiled rice, saffron, and fried onions; seal lid tightly and slow-dum cook.

title: Mutton Keema Pav (Irani Cafe)
instructions: Sauté whole spices and onions until dark golden.
Add mutton keema, fry on high flame until fat renders.
Simmer with spices and coriander; serve with buttery soft pav.

title: Bhuna Gosht (Slow Roasted Mutton)
instructions: Continuous slow roasting (bhunao) of mutton in its own juices and spices until thick, semi-dry, dark brown masala coats the meat.

title: Railway Mutton Curry (Anglo-Indian)
instructions: Cook mutton and halved potatoes with vinegar, spices, and coconut milk for 4 whistles.

title: Mutton Sukka (Madurai Style)
instructions: Cook mutton until tender; roast with shallots, curry leaves, and black pepper until dry and spicy.

title: Kosha Mangsho (Bengali Spicy Mutton)
instructions: Marinate mutton in curd and mustard oil.
Caramelize sugar in smoking oil, brown onions, and slow-bhunao mutton until pitch dark mahogany.

title: Lucknowi Shami Kebab (Melt in Mouth)
instructions: Boil keema with chana dal and whole spices for 3 whistles.
Grind into ultra-silky paste on silbatta, shape flat patties with mint inside, and shallow fry in ghee.

title: Nalli Nihari (Slow Cooked Shank)
instructions: Slow braise mutton shanks with aromatic Nihari spices for 6 whistles.
Thicken gravy with wheat flour slurry and top with sizzling ghee tadka, ginger juliennes, and lemon.

title: Dhaba Mutton Curry (Homestyle)
instructions: Sear mutton with rustic spices, cook 4 whistles in pressure cooker with 2 cups water.

title: Mutton Galouti Kebab
instructions: Marinate velvety lamb paste with tenderizer, shape soft disc patties, and sear gently on a tawa.

title: Mutton Pulao (Yakhni Pulao)
instructions: Simmer mutton with whole spice bouquet garni to extract clear aromatic broth.
Cook basmati rice in the rich yakhni broth with ghee until grains stand tall.

title: Mutton Dalcha (Lentil Mutton Stew)
instructions: Cook mutton and chana dal with bottle gourd until tender; temper with curry leaves and tamarind.

title: Goan Fish Curry (Coconut Kokum)
instructions: Grind coconut with red chillies, coriander seeds, garlic, and cumin into a paste.
Simmer paste with kokum water; gently slide in fish slices and cook 6 minutes.

title: Bengali Macher Jhol (Mustard Gravy)
instructions: Lightly fry turmeric-salted fish in smoking mustard oil.
Temper nigella seeds (kalonji) and green chillies; simmer in light mustard water with potatoes.

title: Crispy Amritsari Fish Fry
instructions: Marinate fish in lemon, ajwain, ginger-garlic, and gram flour.
Shallow fry until crisp and golden. Sprinkle chaat masala.

title: Malabar Prawn Curry
instructions: Cook prawns in earthen clay pot with kudampuli and spices for 5 minutes.
Pour thick coconut milk and finish with hot coconut oil curry leaf tadka.

title: Garlic Butter Pepper Prawns
instructions: Melt butter in skillet, sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Toss in prawns and cook on high flame for 3 minutes until pink and juicy.

title: Tandoori Pomfret
instructions: Marinate scored pomfret with tandoori spices and lemon.
Grill or pan-sear on high heat 5 mins each side until charred and succulent.

title: Kerala Meen Pollichathu (Banana Leaf)
instructions: Pan fry fish 2 minutes; coat in spicy shallot tomato masala.
Wrap tight in wilted banana leaf and pan-roast in coconut oil until flavors infuse deeply.

title: Hyderabadi Prawn Biryani
instructions: Layer spiced marinated prawns with parboiled basmati rice.
Dum cook on low flame 15 minutes so prawns remain tender and sweet.

title: Kolambi Masala (Dry Prawn Fry)
instructions: Sauté prawns with onions, kokum water, and fiery Malvani masala until dry and coated.

title: Fish Tikka (Ajwaini Fish)
instructions: Marinate fish in ajwain, tandoori masala, and lemon juice.
Sear in a hot grill pan for 4 minutes each side.

title: Irani Cafe Mumbai Egg Bhurji
instructions: Sauté onions and chillies in butter until golden.
Add tomatoes and spices, scramble eggs gently until soft and creamy. Serve with pav.

title: Dhaba Style Egg Curry (Boiled & Fried)
instructions: Prick boiled eggs, fry in turmeric-chilli mustard oil until golden blistered crust forms.
Simmer in rich spiced dhaba gravy for 6 minutes.

title: Kolhapuri Egg Curry (Spicy Masala)
instructions: Simmer fried boiled eggs in fiery dark roasted Kolhapuri coconut gravy.

title: Hyderabadi Egg Dum Biryani
instructions: Layer fried spiced eggs with parboiled basmati rice, mint, and saffron milk; dum-cook 15 mins.

title: Street Style Double Egg Roll (Kolkata)

ingredients.name: Sliced Onions, Green Chillies & Kasundi Mustard

instructions: Pour beaten egg on tawa, press flaky paratha on top until attached and crisp.
Roll with crunchy sliced onions, green chillies, and lemon juice.

title: Middle Eastern Shakshuka (Poached Eggs in Tomato Sauce)
instructions: Simmer spiced tomato, garlic, and bell pepper sauce in skillet.
Make hollow wells, crack whole eggs in, cover and cook 5 mins until whites set and yolks run.

title: Masala Omelette with Butter Pav

ingredients.name: Finely Chopped Onion, Tomato, Chillies, Coriander

instructions: Whisk eggs vigorously with chopped onions, chillies, and coriander.
Fry in sizzling butter in hot pan; flip and serve with toasted butter pav.

title: Egg Keema / Anda Ghotala (Surat Style)
instructions: Cook grated boiled eggs into spiced buttery tomato gravy.
Top with sunny-side up fried egg. A Surti street food icon!

title: Egg Roast (Kerala Style)
instructions: Caramelize sliced onions in coconut oil with fennel and pepper.
Toss boiled eggs until coated in thick dark jammy onion masala. Perfect with appams!

title: Egg Paratha (Street Kathi Style)
instructions: Cook paratha, lift edge and pour whisked eggs inside pocket or layer on top.
Cook until crisp on both sides. Hearty, filling breakfast.
